backstory.context: One fictional reader reads before bed instead of scrolling and keeps a small notebook beside the reading chair to note how reading feels. The reader wants to reflect on the meaning of these habits. The four Scenes belong to this one person and evaluation account. Each Scene starts in a fresh conversation with a separately reset empty isolated memory store and capture enabled through application-controlled workflow state. Only its single Line enters Linger. This Backstory and all proposed Ground truth remain outside runtime inputs.
